context.transcript:
All right, let's start our staff meeting. I met with the executive
board yesterday, and after a lot of consideration, they've
decided to move our branch of Summerton Bank to a busier
area of town in the spring. Our branch has been struggling
for quite a while to attract new customers. Our location on
the edge of town is just too far away from people's homes
and jobs. ® We're not moving until spring, but we want to get
the information out now. Flyers will be mailed to all of our
current customers to announce the change, but we'll also
need you to hand them out to customers when they come in.
